description: Recognize all JPEG and PNG photos in one local folder (not its subfolders), one detection per photo, in name order, and write the cards to a new CSV file (and/or a JSON file in the API format) in that folder. CSV columns: file, card_index, name, tcg, language, set_name, set_code, number, rarity, cardmarket_id, Cardmarket trend and 30 day average in EUR, TCGplayer market in USD, confidence, graded, season, subset, parallel, request_id. Costs like recognize_cards: one credit per detected card. The demo key allows only 10 detections per day, so use your own key for folders. Stops at max_files (default 20, at most 100) and on errors that would fail every photo (no credits, invalid key, demo limit). Existing files are never overwritten. With a progress token each photo is reported as it is done.

folder.description: Path to the folder with the photos. ~ is expanded.

max_files.description: At most this many photos, in name order. Default 20.

output.description: Result file(s) to write into the folder. Default csv.

tcg.description: Which game the photos show, one game per folder. Default: pokemon.

name: recognize_folder
title: Recognize every card photo in a folder
